lines.en: label mikudorm40:
scene mikunightmolly1
: Just a second!
lines.zh: : 等一下！

lines.en: I knock on Miku’s door and don’t have to wait for an answer at all.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Miku 的门，根本不用等她应声。

lines.en: I figured there’d be a bit more hesitation considering that the last time the two of us actually got to hang out in here things didn’t really end on a good note.
lines.zh: 想到上次我们俩真正在屋里相处时最后收场得并不愉快，我本以为她会更犹豫一些。

lines.en: In fact, pretty much everything after Miku’s breakdown blurred into one collage of uncertainty and confusion that I’m pretty sure culminated in me just passing out as soon as I got home.
lines.zh: 事实上，Miku 崩溃之后发生的一切，差不多都糊成了一片充满不确定与困惑的拼贴画，而我敢肯定，它的终点就是我刚一到家就昏睡过去。

lines.en: I’m awake now, though.
lines.zh: 不过现在我醒了。

lines.en: I am awake, alert-
lines.zh: 我清醒，警觉——

lines.en: And ready to find new and exciting ways to hurt this girl’s feelings, whether those ways be intentional or not.
lines.zh: 并且准备好去发掘新的、令人兴奋的方式来伤害这个女孩的感情，无论这些方式是有意还是无意。

lines.en: Though I suppose they sound intentional by the way I worded that.
lines.zh: 虽然从我这么说来看，它们听着倒像是故意的。

lines.en: But what difference does the way something is worded really make when any action whatsoever will speak louder than it?
lines.zh: 可当任何行动都比言语更响亮时，措辞又能有多大区别？

lines.en: And what is the point of acting at all if things like destiny are as widely believed as they are?
lines.zh: 再说，如果像命运这种东西已经被这么多人深信不疑，那行动又有什么意义？

lines.en: If I surrender to the prospect of ever doing anything with my life, destiny actually seems like a rather alluring idea.
lines.zh: 如果我放弃“这辈子还要干点什么”的指望，命运其实倒是个相当迷人的念头。

lines.en: I wish I was naive enough to believe in something like that.
lines.zh: 我真希望自己能天真到去相信那种东西。

lines.en: I suppose I’ll just stick to actions for the time being.
lines.zh: 我想，暂时还是继续靠行动吧。

lines.en: Or at least until something better comes along.
lines.zh: 至少在更好的东西出现之前是这样。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly2
: Uh...hey. I had a feelin’ it was gonna be you.
lines.zh: : 呃……嘿。我就猜到会是你。

lines.en: : Yup. I’m here for another one of the “Miku apologizes for something she doesn’t have to apologize for” meetings.
lines.zh: : 对。我是来参加新一届“Miku 为自己根本不必道歉的事道歉”大会的。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly3
: Is it okay if we hold the meeting outside tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚的会能不能改在外面开？

lines.en: : It’s not really somethin’ I feel comfortable talkin’ about in the dorms.
lines.zh: : 这种事在宿舍里说，我实在自在不起来。

lines.en: : Especially with Yumi right next to us...
lines.zh: : 尤其是 Yumi 就在隔壁……

lines.en: : Hi, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Yumi。

lines.en: : The fuck are you two lookin’ at me for? Wasn't planning on interrupting.
lines.zh: : 你俩盯着我干什么？我可没打算打扰。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly3
: So...is that okay, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 所以……可以吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sure, going somewhere else is totally fine. Is there anywhere you had in mind?
lines.zh: : 当然，换个地方完全没问题。你有想去的地方吗？

lines.en: : Just...outside on the bench is fine. We don’t really need to go anywhere since all we’re gonna be doin’ is talkin’ anyway.
lines.zh: : 就……外面的长椅就行。反正我们只是聊聊天，也不用特意去哪儿。

lines.en: : Well, I guess just...lead the way then.
lines.zh: : 那……就你带路吧。

lines.en: scene black
Miku nods at me and makes her way down the hall.
lines.zh: Miku 朝我点了点头，沿着走廊往前走。

lines.en: And then the stairs.
lines.zh: 然后是楼梯。

lines.en: Uta and Io, who are apparently just now getting home, notice us and begin to make their way over, but I wave them off and they awkwardly turn around and reroute themselves down another wing of the hallway.
lines.zh: 看起来刚回来的 Uta 和 Io 注意到了我们，开始朝这边走来，但我挥手把她们打发走，两人尴尬地转身，改道走向走廊的另一侧。

lines.en: Miku never notices anything as her gaze has been fixed on the floor this entire time.
lines.zh: Miku 什么都没注意到，她的目光从头到尾都钉在地板上。

lines.en: It isn’t until we get outside that her eyes trail back upward, skipping over me and landing somewhere among the stars as she subconsciously inches her way over to a nearby park bench.
lines.zh: 直到我们走到外面，她的视线才重新往上移，掠过我，落在群星之间的某处，同时无意识地一点点挪向附近的一张公园长椅。

lines.en: scene nightsky
That bench winds up being very cold.
lines.zh: 那张长椅结果非常冰。

lines.en: And, unlike Miku, I’m not dressed for arctic temperatures.
lines.zh: 而且，不像 Miku，我可没穿成能应付极地气温的样子。

lines.en: It winds up chilling me to the bone as a result.
lines.zh: 结果我被冻了个透心凉。

lines.en: And I can’t even move closer to her for warmth because if all of the misfortune in the world shows up at the same time again, Miku might begin to associate me with disaster.
lines.zh: 而我又不能凑近她取暖，因为万一世上所有的倒霉事再一次同时降临，Miku 说不定就会开始把我跟灾难联系在一起。

lines.en: Kind of like how a dog would begin to fear a human being if the dog was struck by lightning each time that human showed up.
lines.zh: 有点像那样：如果每次某个人一出现，狗就会被雷劈，那狗就会开始害怕这个人。

lines.en: I’m sure that analogy is all sorts of unnecessarily confusing, but association is easier to explain with animals and it is once again too cold for me to come up with anything better.
lines.zh: 我敢说这个类比实在多余地令人费解，不过用动物来解释“联想”要简单些，而且眼下又太冷了，我实在想不出更好的说法。

lines.en: You will have to take what you can get for now.
lines.zh: 暂时只能将就着看吧。

lines.en: And contrary to how I normally desire to live-
lines.zh: 而与我一贯渴望的生活方式相反——

lines.en: Contrary to what my fake destiny predicts for me-
lines.zh: 与我那虚假的命运替我预言的一切相反——

lines.en: I must take nothing.
lines.zh: 我必须什么都拿不到。

lines.en: I must take nothing and hear something.
lines.zh: 我必须什么都拿不到，只听得见些什么。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly5
: ...So, I guess I’ll just get the apology outta the way now, huh?
lines.zh: : ……那么，我看我还是先把道歉给说了吧？

lines.en: : And I guess I’ll get my obligatory, “Don’t apologize for things that are out of your control” out of the way as well.
lines.zh: : 那我也把我那句例行的“别为超出你控制的事道歉”先说了吧。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly6
: This time was a little different, though...
lines.zh: : 不过这次有点不一样……

lines.en: : I mean...with Makoto showin’ up and me not havin’ a shirt on and stuff...
lines.zh: : 我是说……Makoto 突然出现，而我还没穿上衣什么的……

lines.en: : She actually wound up apologizing about that for some reason. I never really bothered asking why though, because...yeah.
lines.zh: : 不知为什么，她反倒为了那件事道歉了。我也没真去问为什么，因为……唉，你懂的。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly7
: I was able to convince her it was all some sort of misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 我总算让她相信那只是个误会。

lines.en: : Were you? Because I feel like Makoto is one of the last people to believe that me being in a room with a shirtless girl is ever a misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我倒觉得，要相信“我和一个没穿上衣的女孩同处一室纯属误会”，Makoto 大概是最不可能的人之一。

lines.en: : Course I can’t speak for her, but she trusts me...so she was willing to hear me out and all that.
lines.zh: : 我当然不能替她说话，但她信任我……所以她愿意听我把话说完之类的。

lines.en: : Once I...stopped actin’ all weird, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，在我……不再那么反常之后。

lines.en: : Is there...something I should be doing when that happens? Because I normally just freeze up and let it play out.
lines.zh: : 那种时候……我是不是该做点什么？因为我平时只会僵在原地，任其发展。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly8
: Nuh-uh! You did totally fine during the thunderstorm that one time!
lines.zh: : 才不是！那次雷雨的时候你做得很好啊！

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t really remember what ya did in the first place, but I remember not bein’ as scared as I probably should’ve been in front of some random store in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我其实不太记得你当时做了什么，但我记得半夜在一家不知什么店门口，我并没有像本该的那样害怕。

lines.en: : It’s gettin’ kinda annoying always havin’ you around for that stuff when it happens, though. Like, what the heck gives?
lines.zh: : 不过每次出这种事你都在场，这让我有点烦了。到底是怎么回事啊？

lines.en: : I’m not always there. It happens a lot when I’m not around, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我也不总是在场吧。我不在的时候它也经常发生，不是吗？

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly9
: I’m guessin’ Makoto told ya that?
lines.zh: : 我猜是 Makoto 跟你说的？

lines.en: : You were a relatively popular conversation topic on the beach.
lines.zh: : 在海边的时候，你算是个挺热门的话题。

lines.en: : The only reason I was at the beach in the first place was because of my...problem.
lines.zh: : 我之所以会去海边，一开始就是因为我的那个……毛病。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what to call it since I’ve never gotten one of those diagnosis things.
lines.zh: : 我连该怎么称呼它都不知道，毕竟我从没去做过什么诊断。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly10
: But...I’m practicing!
lines.zh: : 但是……我在练习！

lines.en: : Trainin’ just as hard with that as I am for soccer and stuff!
lines.zh: : 就像练足球那样拼命地练！

lines.en: : I’ve been turnin’ up the volume on the TV and...listenin’ to music with headphones on. All kinds of stuff!
lines.zh: : 我把电视音量开大，还……戴着耳机听音乐。各种各样的办法！

lines.en: : And pretty soon I’ll be able to do things like...light fireworks or...go to concerts or something!
lines.zh: : 用不了多久我就能……放烟花，或者……去听演唱会什么的！

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly11
: And I won’t have to worry about blackin’ out every time there’s a loud bang...
lines.zh: : 这样每次有巨响的时候，我就不用担心自己会昏过去了……

lines.en: : Or makin’ a big inconvenience for everybody other than Makoto or Karin, who have already figured out how to calm me down...
lines.zh: : 也不用再给除了 Makoto 和 Karin 之外的人添大麻烦——她们俩早就摸清了怎么让我平静下来……

lines.en: : So...yeah...I’m practicing really hard...
lines.zh: : 所以……嗯……我真的练得很努力……

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to tell me why-
lines.zh: : 你真的不想告诉我为什么——

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly12
: Um!
As expected, Miku cuts in before she even has anything to say.
lines.zh: 不出所料，Miku 在还没想好要说什么之前就打断了我。

lines.en: It's desperation at its finest.
lines.zh: 这是最纯粹的狼狈。

lines.en: She wasn’t ready to talk about whatever happened (Or is happening) to her after the first breakdown and she’s still not ready now after the third.
lines.zh: 第一次崩溃之后，她还没准备好谈论自己身上发生过（或者正在发生）什么；如今都第三次了，她依旧没准备好。

lines.en: And I can’t even tell if I’m closer to or further away from finding out now that I can do things like take her clothes off while her roommate is away.
lines.zh: 现在我都能趁着她室友不在脱她衣服了，可我反而说不清自己离真相是更近了，还是更远了。

lines.en: This would feel like progress for most girls.
lines.zh: 换成大多数女孩，这都算是进展了。

lines.en: But, in some twisted sort of way, it feels like things might be moving backwards on some fronts.
lines.zh: 但以一种扭曲的方式来看，某些方面反而像是在倒退。

lines.en: Especially now that Miku has essentially come out and said that she hasn’t really been thinking of something like a future with me and is just acting...hormonal.
lines.zh: 尤其是 Miku 基本上已经明说了，她并没有真的想过和我的未来之类的事，只是……荷尔蒙作祟。

lines.en: But that’s too simple. Things are never that simple.
lines.zh: 可这也太简单了。事情从来没那么简单。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly13
: Um...it’s not that I...don’t want to tell you...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不是……不想告诉你……

lines.en: : Let me guess-
lines.zh: : 让我猜猜——

lines.en: : It’s that you can’t.
lines.zh: : 而是你说不出口。

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: B-Besides! We’ve got bigger fish to fry anyway, right Sensei?
lines.zh: : 再——再说！我们还有更要紧的事要操心呢，对吧 Sensei？

lines.en: : Do we?
lines.zh: : 有吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...cause like...now that we’ve almost been...caught by Makoto-
lines.zh: : 有啊……因为……上次我们差点就被 Makoto……抓个正着——

lines.en: : We should probably...kinda like...cut things off, you know?
lines.zh: : 我们大概应该……怎么说呢……到此为止了吧？

lines.en: : Am I being dumped from a relationship that hasn’t even started yet?
lines.zh: : 我这是在被一段根本还没开始的关系甩掉吗？

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly12
: No! I still like spendin’ time with you and wanna keep doin’ that...just...
lines.zh: : 不是！我还是喜欢跟你待在一起，也想继续……只是……

lines.en: : That whole thing was kind of a wake up call...
lines.zh: : 那整件事算是个警钟吧……

lines.en: : Do you know why Makoto was able to make it over so fast last night, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你知道昨晚 Makoto 为什么能那么快赶过来吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I just figured it was a coincidence.
lines.zh: : 我只当是巧合。

lines.en: : It’s because she came runnin’ the second she heard that bang upstairs.
lines.zh: : 因为楼上一响，她立刻就跑了过来。

lines.en: : It's like a friggin’ reflex for her.
lines.zh: : 对她来说简直就是他妈的条件反射。

lines.en: : She didn’t even think to check on where it came from or what happened, just bolted right over to our room because she knows how I am.
lines.zh: : 她连想都没想那声音是从哪儿来的、发生了什么，直接就冲进了我们房间，因为她太了解我了。

lines.en: : And if somethin’ like that were to happen while you and I were...you know...
lines.zh: : 要是那种事发生在你和我正……那个……的时候——

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly14
: I wouldn’t be able to explain it all away again...
lines.zh: : 我就没办法再把它圆过去了……

lines.en: : Well there’s always other places we can-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们总还有别的地方可以——

lines.en: : You’re...not gettin’ it, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你……没明白我的意思，Sensei……

lines.en: : If I can’t even feel comfortable tellin’ you why I get like that, do you really think I’m comfortable enough to start doing more...adult-ish things with you?
lines.zh: : 如果我连自己为什么会变成那样都没办法自在地告诉你，你觉得我有可能自在到跟你做更……大人一点的事吗？

lines.en: : I just think you should be doing what you want to do.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你应该做自己想做的事。

lines.en: : That’s how I’ve always lived and I turned out fine.
lines.zh: : 我一直都是这么活的，结果也不坏。

lines.en: : It has nothin’ to do with what I want...it’s more about what I can and can’t do.
lines.zh: : 这跟我想不想没关系……更多是我做得到和做不到的事。

lines.en: : I’m pretty friggin’ good at soccer, but if I went out there and was asked to play goalie for a match, I’d be completely useless.
lines.zh: : 我足球踢得相当他妈的好，可要是上场被叫去当守门员，我绝对是个废物。

lines.en: : Bein’ with you is kinda like that.
lines.zh: : 跟你在一起就有点像那样。

lines.en: : I just got thrown into it all of a sudden and now everything is goin' super fast and I don’t even know if I like bein’ a goalie yet.
lines.zh: : 我突然就被扔了进去，现在一切都快得要命，而我连自己喜不喜欢当守门员都还不知道。

lines.en: : And Makoto-
lines.zh: : 还有 Makoto——

lines.en: : I’m assuming you’re about to tell me that Makoto is a good goalie and that you feel like you’d be taking her position even if you did train?
lines.zh: : 我猜你接下来要说，Makoto 是个好守门员，就算你练了，也觉得自己是在抢她的位置？

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly15
: You adults really are smart. I didn’t even have to finish talkin’ for you to get what I meant.
lines.zh: : 你们大人真的好聪明。我话都没说完，你就明白我的意思了。

lines.en: : Just some standard pattern recognition.
lines.zh: : 只是常规的模式识别罢了。

lines.en: : I push...you back off...you blame yourself...you bring up Makoto...and then things happen anyway.
lines.zh: : 我推开你……你退回去……你自责……你提起 Makoto……然后事情还是照旧发生了。

lines.en: : So take a friggin’ hint and stop makin’ things happen.
lines.zh: : 所以你就他妈的识相点，别再让事情发生了。

lines.en: : You’re smarter and bigger than me and I think you’re really cool so...all that combined means I’m easy to trick.
lines.zh: : 你比我聪明，比我高大，我又觉得你特别酷，所以……这些加在一起，就意味着我很容易被套路。

lines.en: : I can’t be that much smarter than you if you’ve already figured out my tactics.
lines.zh: : 既然你都看穿我的战术了，那我也没比你聪明多少。

lines.en: : There are some girls I’ve spent a lot more time with who still don’t understand that.
lines.zh: : 有些我花了更多时间相处的女孩，到现在还不明白这一点呢。

lines.en: : It got easier once I started thinkin’ of you like I think about soccer.
lines.zh: : 自从我开始像琢磨足球那样琢磨你，一切就简单多了。

lines.en: : First rule of playin’ a team stronger than you is to analyze their weaknesses and come up with a plan of attack.
lines.zh: : 对阵比自己强的队伍，第一条规矩就是分析对手的弱点，然后制定进攻方案。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t your plan of attack be that cycle I mentioned before, then?
lines.zh: : 那你的进攻方案，不就是我刚才说的那个循环吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. But another thing you need to always be prepared for when playin’ a stronger team is for your plan of attack to fail.
lines.zh: : 对。但对阵强队时，你必须时刻做好的另一手准备，就是你的进攻方案会失败。

lines.en: : Ahh, so we’ve moved into Miku Maruyama’s “Plan B.”
lines.zh: : 啊，所以现在已经进入 Miku Maruyama 的“B 计划”了。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly16
: Heck yeah we have! You’ve fallen right into my trap!
lines.zh: : 那还用说！你正中我的下怀！

lines.en: : What’s the backup plan then? How are you going to stop me when you seem to already know how I’m going to handle this?
lines.zh: : 那备用计划是什么？你既然已经知道我会怎么应对，又打算怎么拦住我？

lines.en: : Easy!
lines.zh: : 简单！

lines.en: : I’m subbin’ myself out and becomin’ a player-coach.
lines.zh: : 我把自己换下场，改当球员兼教练。

lines.en: : Now I’m Team Makoto all the way! Puttin’ all my eggs in the basket of the same girl who cares more about me than she does herself.
lines.zh: : 从现在起我彻底是“Makoto 队”的人！把全部鸡蛋都放进那个关心我胜过关心她自己的女孩的篮子里。

lines.en: : And you think that’s something that will make you happy?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那样能让你幸福吗？

lines.en: : Happy as a peach!
lines.zh: : 幸福得像只桃子！

lines.en: : That’s not a phrase, Miku.
lines.zh: : 没这个说法，Miku。

lines.en: : Cool as a cucumber!
lines.zh: : 冷静得像根黄瓜！

lines.en: : That one is, but it doesn’t really apply right now.
lines.zh: : 这个说法倒是有，不过现在不太适用。

lines.en: : When life gives you lemons, make beef stew!
lines.zh: : 生活给你柠檬，就炖一锅牛肉汤！

lines.en: : And that’s just an obscure reference to an early 2000’s TV show that neither of us should know about given our Japanese upbringing and inexposure to American culture.
lines.zh: : 而这不过是个二十一世纪初电视剧的冷门梗，考虑到我们都是日本长大、又没怎么接触过美国文化，本来谁都不该知道的。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly17
: You should be with her, Sensei. Not me.
lines.zh: : 你应该跟她在一起，Sensei。不是我。

lines.en: : What we’re doin’ right now doesn’t make sense for either one of us.
lines.zh: : 我们现在做的这些，对我们俩都没意义。

lines.en: : She needs you.
lines.zh: : 她需要你。

lines.en: : And you don’t?
lines.zh: : 你不需要？

lines.en: : Why the heck would I need you? You’re a bad coach and an even worse teacher.
lines.zh: : 我为什么会需要你啊？你是个糟糕的教练，更是个烂老师。

lines.en: : Wow. Why wasn’t this your plan of attack from the get go?
lines.zh: : 哇。你怎么不从一开始就用这套进攻方案？

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly18
: Because wordin’ it like this makes me sound like a quitter. And if there’s anythin’ Miku Maruyama hates, it’s quitters!
lines.zh: : 因为这么说我听着就像个逃兵。而 Miku Maruyama 最讨厌的，就是逃兵！

lines.en: : So without givin’ you time to come up with a backup plan of your own, I’m gonna end things right here!
lines.zh: : 所以趁你还没想出自己的备用计划，我现在就把事情了结！

lines.en: : And we’re gonna go back to bein’ buds who keep any weird thoughts we have about each other to ourselves instead of airin’ em out under the covers next to the real heroine of this story!
lines.zh: : 我们要重新做回好哥们，把对彼此那些奇怪的念头全憋在心里，而不是躲在这故事真正女主角旁边的被窝里摊开来讲！

lines.en: : Ohoho~ What’s this I hear about the real heroine?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵～我好像听到了“真正的女主角”？

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly19
: Oh, Molly! Nothin’ to see here! Just two buds doin’ bud stuff!
lines.zh: : 哦，Molly！这儿没什么好看的！就是两个哥们儿在干哥们儿的事！

lines.en: : Cloaked in darkness, a beautiful stranger emerges from the shadows, bringing with her the gift of eternal love and unending...joy!
lines.zh: : 披着夜色，一位美丽的陌生人自阴影中现身，带来了永恒之爱与无尽……欢愉的馈赠！

lines.en: : It is she! The main heroine of the-
lines.zh: : 就是她！本作的女主角——

lines.en: : Oh, no. I was talkin’ about Makoto when I mentioned the main heroine.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。我刚才说女主角的时候，说的是 Makoto。

lines.en: : I’m on her team full time now.
lines.zh: : 我现在全职在她那队了。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly20
: ...I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. We weren’t talkin’ about you at all, but you’re welcome to join us if ya want.
lines.zh: : 对啊。我们压根没在说你，不过你想加入也欢迎。

lines.en: : Sorry, Molly. But keep up the good work. You’ve already seamlessly blended into the harem.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，Molly。不过继续努力，你已经完美地融入后宫了。

lines.en: : I need to put more points into charisma...
lines.zh: : 我得再多加点魅力值……

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly21
: Oh...and um...Miku-
lines.zh: : 哦……还有，嗯……Miku——

lines.en: : I’m really sorry for adding to the noise the other night...even if it was mostly our neighbors' fault.
lines.zh: : 前天晚上我又添了那么多噪音，真的很抱歉……虽然大部分是我们邻居的错。

lines.en: : It completely slipped my mind how much things like that upset you.
lines.zh: : 我完全忘了那种事有多让你难受。

lines.en: : I’ll do better to try and keep quiet. Really.
lines.zh: : 我会尽量注意安静的。真的。

lines.en: : Oh...you don’t have to apologize for that...
lines.zh: : 哦……这事你不用道歉……

lines.en: : It’s not like I expect everybody to work around me or anything.
lines.zh: : 我也没指望所有人都围着我转什么的。

lines.en: : I highly doubt Molly will succeed in her mission to remain quiet anyway. That’s probably her greatest weakness.
lines.zh: : 我严重怀疑 Molly 那“保持安静”的任务根本不可能成功。那大概是她最大的弱点。

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly22
: Lies! My greatest weakness is fire!
lines.zh: : 谎言！我最大的弱点是火！

lines.en: : Shows how much you know about grass types, Supreme Overlord!
lines.zh: : 看来你对草属性一无所知啊，至高霸主！

lines.en: scene mikunightmolly23
: I guess we should probably head back inside now, huh?
lines.zh: : 我看我们该回屋里去了吧？

lines.en: : Is your backup plan complete?
lines.zh: : 你的备用计划完成了？

lines.en: : It’s not really a thing that ever finishes...
lines.zh: : 这东西哪有什么完成的时候……

lines.en: : The game’s on an infinite timer and I’ve just gotta keep the ball away from ya as long as possible.
lines.zh: : 比赛是无限时长，我只要尽可能久地把球从你脚下断走就行。

lines.en: : Well then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Here’s hoping our legs don’t tire out.
lines.zh: : 只希望我们的腿别先累垮。

lines.en: scene black
I see no need to walk Miku back to her room now that Molly has waltzed into the picture.
lines.zh: 既然 Molly 已经闯进画面，我觉得没必要再送 Miku 回房间了。

lines.en: I also see no need for Miku to do something as drastic as giving up on her feelings just so she can support someone else’s.
lines.zh: 我也觉得 Miku 没必要做到放弃自己的感情这种极端的地步，只为去成全别人的感情。

lines.en: That amount of selflessness can kill someone.
lines.zh: 那种程度的无私是会要人命的。

lines.en: You can’t force people into relationships they don’t want to be a part of, though.
lines.zh: 不过，你也没法逼别人进入一段他们根本不想参与的关系。

lines.en: Which is not me saying, by any stretch of the imagination, that I wanted a “relationship” with Miku.
lines.zh: 当然，这绝不是说我想和 Miku 谈什么“恋爱”。

lines.en: But I wanted something.
lines.zh: 但我想要点什么。

lines.en: And I almost got something.
lines.zh: 而且我差点就得到了。

lines.en: But now, with her finally deciding to do something on her own instead of letting me drag her along-
lines.zh: 可现在，她终于决定自己拿主意，而不是被我一路拖着走——

lines.en: I’ve somehow wound up falling behind.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我反倒落在了后面。

lines.en: That’s not how this is supposed to work.
lines.zh: 事情本不该是这样发展的。

lines.en: I look up at the sky as I begin to head home and the light from the moon stings my eyes.
lines.zh: 我踏上回家的路，抬头望向天空，月光刺痛了我的眼睛。

lines.en: A short while later, I receive an apology text from Miku.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，我收到了 Miku 发来的道歉短信。

lines.en: It’s a lot less detailed than Makoto’s was.
lines.zh: 它比 Makoto 那封简略得多。

lines.en: It explains nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都没解释。

lines.en: Just says, “I’m sorry.”
lines.zh: 只有一句“对不起”。

lines.en: I put my phone back in my pocket.
lines.zh: 我把手机放回口袋。

lines.en: I think about responding and telling her not to worry about it, but I know that tends to have a subconscious effect on people that often forces them to do the exact opposite.
lines.zh: 我想过回她一句“别放在心上”，但我知道这种话往往会在潜意识里起作用，逼着人做出完全相反的事。

lines.en: At the end of the day, I am not happy with how things ended up.
lines.zh: 说到底，我对这个结局并不满意。

lines.en: And I don’t think Miku is either.
lines.zh: 我想 Miku 也不满意。

lines.en: But I suppose that this is the path that we’ll have to walk until I manage to steal the ball back.
lines.zh: 不过我想，在我把球断回来之前，这条路我们只能这么走下去了。
